messages:
nora: Quick announcement: on 2026-05-10 we9re changing repo ownership mapping and enforcing GitHub org-level CODEOWNERS validation. Window: 2026-05-10 01:00 -> 04:00 UTC. This affects automated perms, Jira link syncs, and protected-branch checks.

ben: What exactly changes for repo owners?

nora: Two things: 1) we9ll canonicalize owners using the new owners-service (takes precedence over in-repo CODEOWNERS where conflict exists), 2) we9ll block merges if org-owned repos don9t have an approved owners-service entry. This helps with oncall routing and product ownership.

kai: Does this touch Jira project links? We sync assignees by CODEOWNER info today.

nora: Yes 4 Jira sync will switch to owners-service as the canonical source. If a repo lacks mapping, the sync will set assignee to the current team fallback (team-rotation). We9ll post migration mapping CSV.

repo-scanner-bot: SCAN: found 48 repos with ambiguous CODEOWNERS (multiple team aliases). List will be posted to the owners migration doc.

ben: Canary plan?

nora: Canary order: infra/* -> internal-tools/* -> product/* -> external/* . First canary 02:00 UTC on the 10th with infra/deploy and internal-tools/ci-config. Monitor merge queue and Jira sync for 60m.

kai: If a repo fails the new check, will it block CI?

platform-oncall: Merge check blocks only PR merges. CI jobs will continue but the final status check will fail. Owners can override via an owner-approval workflow for emergency merges (audit logged).

idp-bot: NOTICE: owners-service requires SSO-linked GitHub accounts for owners to be valid. Non-SSO accounts will be rejected.

ben: What about external contractors who lack Okta SSO?

nora: Contractors must be added to an org-managed team and we provide a temporary partner-ownership token for 72h. Long-term, they need SSO or a formal vendor exception.

kai: Migration steps for repo owners: 1) review owners-service mapping doc, 2) confirm owners via the PR template, 3) update CODEOWNERS if needed, 4) run owners-service dry-run.

nora: I9ll publish the mapping CSV + PR template in #devex in 20m. Exceptions require a ticket to secops with justification.

ben: If something goes wrong, rollback path?

platform-oncall: We can flip org feature flag to "owners-legacy" which defers to in-repo CODEOWNERS for 2h. Use oncall to request the flip. All overrides are logged.

nora: Thanks all. Action: owners must ack this thread by EOD Mon 2026-05-08. I9ll ping teams with ambiguous mappings. :eyes:
